Who your campaigns and other touches brought in, how their revenue grows, whether tracking works,
every built-in chart, and alerts on events that look broken.

Usage:
  voidhash analytics <command> [flags]

Commands:
  acquisition  Report the people each campaign or other touch brought in, and what they paid.
  cohorts      Show how revenue from people acquired each week grows over time.
  health       Check that web and app tracking report what measuring ads relies on.
  charts       List the built-in charts.
  chart        Run one of the built-in charts.
  alerts       Rules that tell owners and admins when events or money look wrong.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash analytics <command> --help' for more about a command.
